articles.summary: Happy holidays from all of us at Lendflow! As we head into the final stretch of the year and look ahead to 2026, we’re grateful for all of our partners and the broader lending community for the support and inspiration this year. We're proud of the innovation of our team and excited to jump into 2026 with momentum. In this month’s newsletter, we’re sharing how Lendflow is building smarter lending infrastructure, plus a first look at Command Bar and our vision for an AI-native, agentic-first lending platform.
articles.title: Lendflow Roundup | December

articles.summary: Today, we’re taking an exciting step toward the future of AI lending technology with the launch of Command Bar, a unified interface that represents our vision for an AI-native, agentic-first platform built to automate and simplify processes.
articles.title: Command Bar: Building Intelligence Into Every Lending Workflow

articles.summary: The small business lending world has been stuck in a frustrating pattern. Lenders have high operational costs trying to stay competitive. Borrowers are bouncing between applications, facing rejection with little guidance on where to turn next. Everyone knows the system could work better, it just needs the right infrastructure to make it happen.
articles.title: How Lendflow is Building Smarter Lending Infrastructure
